title: Ned and the Fish
checkpoint: Reception Spring 1, week 4 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds ai, ee, igh
note_for_grown_ups: The new sounds here are the digraphs ch, sh, th and ng — two letters that make one sound. Point them out as one unit ('sh', not 's-h') when your child sounds out words like fish, dash, this and pond.

pages.illustration: Ned the duckling holding a small green fishing net on a bamboo cane far too long for him, the handle wobbling wildly. Bright, keen, slightly out of control.

pages.text: Ned ran off with a dash.
pages.illustration: Ned running full pelt down the bank towards the pond, net trailing behind him, grass flattening in his wake. Strong left-to-right motion.

pages.text: A fish! The fish was red.
pages.illustration: The moment of discovery: a bright red fish suspended in clear green pond water, seen from above, with Ned's astonished face reflected on the surface.

pages.text: The fish did a quick zigzag.
pages.illustration: The fish darting through the water in a sharp zigzag, a trail of bubbles marking its path. Ned's face at the water's edge, wide-eyed.

pages.text: Ned got the fish in his net.
pages.illustration: Ned holding the net up triumphantly with the red fish inside it, water streaming out through the mesh. His chest is out; he has never been prouder.

pages.text: Pip and Nell run up to Ned.
pages.illustration: Pip and Nell arriving at speed from opposite sides of the frame, both mid-flight, converging on Ned. Busy and excited.

pages.text: We can put it back in!
pages.illustration: Three friends in close conference over the net, heads together, the fish visible between them looking distinctly unhappy. The decision page — make it feel like a decision.
Ned tipping the net gently towards the water, the fish sliding out, his face careful and serious. Slow, quiet composition after all the movement.
Big splash: the fish diving away with a bright arc of water thrown up, seen from the bank. Ned soaked and laughing.

pages.text: Ned and his pals had fun.
pages.illustration: Closing page: all three sitting in a row on the bank at golden hour, feet in the water, the empty net laid down beside them. Warm, still, satisfied.
